newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes lower as blue chips fall back.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes lower as blue chips fall back.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index slipped back on Thursday after posting a two-year high of 603 in the previous session.
The PX50 index lost 0.3 percent to 601.4 with the RPIX index of continuously traded shares falling by the same amount to 1,280.2.
Major issues were mainly down and dealers said there was little interest in the blue chips from foreign investors.
"Today the market looks quiet. There is nothing much happening in the blue chips," said Ivan Kusacek of Zivnostenska Banka in Prague.

SPT Telecom was the only gainer among the major issues rising nine crowns to 3,769. CEZ dropped five crowns to 1,240. Komercni Banka fell 40 crowns to 2,645 and Ceska Sporitelna dropped three crowns to 324.
"I would expect that the prices of the blue chips are going to go down during the next week," Kusacek added.

Dealers warned that recent gains from major issues had been made on generally low volumes, and in the absence of new information on company fundamentals they were sceptical about short term prospects for the blue chips.
